title: Under-declared or oversized parcels (customer side)
keywords: under-declared oversized too big heavier refuse 50% refund maximum size 25kg 200cm
body: Maximum size: under 200 cm (L + W + H) and 25 kg. Larger items should be split into two parcels and booked to the same address (bulk discount applies).
If a parcel is under-declared, the agent may refuse it. If refused, the customer gets a 50% refund of the original fee.
Agent may instead deliver with the sender's written approval and upload a weight/size photo; the extra charge is then applied.
